bug_semantics: phpMyFAQ's admin API read endpoints for configuration-adjacent data gate access with `userIsAuthenticated()` (any valid logged-in session) instead of `userHasPermission(PermissionType::CONFIGURATION_EDIT)` (admin configuration right). Affected endpoints: LdapController::configuration/healthcheck (LDAP server topology, bind account names, search bases), ElasticsearchController::statistics and OpenSearchController::statistics (index names, index statistics), DashboardController configuration reads, plus StopWordController and UpdateController read actions. Any authenticated user — not just configuration administrators — retrieves sensitive administrative data (CWE-862 Missing Authorization).
flaw_origin: Two-part origin, both by maintainer Thorsten Rinne <thorsten@phpmyfaq.de>: (1) fd4145e6c56cb3b36757b2ab7ab7a4c9bbf7225b ("feat: added permission checks", 2024-01-14) added the permission split to ElasticsearchController — create/drop/import got `userHasPermission(CONFIGURATION_EDIT)` while the read-only `statistics()` got only `userIsAuthenticated()`, establishing the under-protected read endpoint; (2) b691aa720098affec8acd12666970489123d7503 ("feat: added LDAP configuration frontend, added a lot of more tests", 2026-03-05) created LdapController.php whose `configuration()` and `healthcheck()` repeat the same `userIsAuthenticated()`-only guard (parent 4d713d5be3 lacks the file). The advisory's affected set is the union of these two defective decisions.
ai_marker: absent — the BIC commit object names author and committer Thorsten Rinne <thorsten@phpmyfaq.de> (2026-03-05), human feature message; no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or bot/AI identity anywhere on the object (also verified on fd4145e6).

Same commit modifies DashboardController.php (config read paths).', 'Second-wave check: fd4145e6c56c (2024-01-14) added to ElasticsearchController `userHasPermission(CONFIGURATION_EDIT)` on create/drop/import but `$this->userIsAuthenticated()` on `statistics()` — the read endpoint born under-protected; the controller itself originated 55bffcaf01c1 (2023-10-26) without ANY auth guard on statistics. OpenSearchController mirrors Elasticsearch; StopWordController/UpdateController read actions likewise authenticated-only, all corrected by the fix.', 'Fix commit e419af428019 (2026-08-01, Thorsten Rinne, "fix(security): require CONFIGURATION_EDIT on admin API read endpoints"): in Elasticsearch/Ldap/OpenSearch/StopWord/Update controllers replaces every affected `$this->userIsAuthenticated()` with `$this->userHasPermission(PermissionType::CONFIGURATION_EDIT)` and adds controller tests asserting denial for plain authenticated users (5 test files, 265 insertions). First shipped in tag 4.1.7, matching the advisory\'s fixed version.', 'Version boundary: LdapController first tagged 4.0-nightly-2026-03-06 lineage (4.0/4.1 development lines); the statistics guard split first tagged the 4.0 nightly 2024 lineage; vulnerable through 4.1.6; fixed first in 4.1.7.', "AI-marker screening: `git log --format='%an <%ae>%n%cn <%ce>%n%B' -1 b691aa720098` and `-1 fd4145e6c56c` — only Thorsten Rinne; grep for claude/copilot/anthropic/openai/generated/co-authored/cursor/junie finds nothing (NONE sentinels)."] introducer_parent corrected from 4d713d5be335aac70774174944cf09be33ba6aa2 to 09624180b81b8829438fc8717b4207d6f24f913b (reconciliation 2026-08-29: git log -1 --format='%P' 0f98f808b568 -> 09624180b81b; cat-file -e 09624180b81b:phpmyfaq/src/phpMyFAQ/Controller/Administration/DashboardController.php -> ABSENT. P's parent 4d713d5be335 pairs with it) Fix union 2026-08-29 (corrected same day after clone re-verification): e419af42 and 198fc041 are parallel same-day commits by Thorsten Rinne (neither an ancestor of the other; both reachable from main). Their file sets overlap (both touch Elasticsearch/OpenSearch/StopWord/Update controllers), but each uniquely covers an advisory endpoint the other lacks: e419af42 alone fixes LdapController (configuration/healthcheck); 198fc041 alone fixes DashboardController reads. Neither commit alone covers all advisory-named endpoints; fix_sha=e419af4280198f65a787bba588689ededf8c2610 (Ldap half) + direct_fix_sha=198fc0411c036e9dadf1ebd375ff5e873446b410 (Dashboard half) together are required. Residual: 4 further dashboard routes (news/layout get/save/reset) still call userIsAuthenticated() at HEAD — outside this advisory's named endpoints, noted for completeness. Introducer reconciliation 2026-08-29: P and R describe different first-writes of the same unauthenticated-admin-read flaw class (P: b691aa720098; R: 0f98f808b568). Both verified at line level; primary retains P's commit as the introducer with this dual-first-write note.
reasoning: Field reconciliation 2026-08-29 (see evidence tail). Vulnerability first: the advisory names missing CONFIGURATION_EDIT enforcement on the named admin read endpoints; the fix converts exactly those endpoints from userIsAuthenticated() to userHasPermission(CONFIGURATION_EDIT) with denial tests, proving the weaker guard is the defect. BIC choice: the advisory's most sensitive newly-exposed surface (LDAP configuration topology/bind accounts) was born under-protected at b691aa720098 (2026-03-05) creating LdapController with authenticated-only guards; the Elasticsearch/OpenSearch statistics endpoint got its weaker-than-write guard at fd4145e6c56c (2024-01-14) and its origin at 55bffcaf01c1 — recorded as decomposed waves of the same missing-authorization design (squash_decomposed=true, decomposed_shas listed), with the BIC anchored on the newest introducer commit of an affected endpoint. Squash check: b691aa72 is a large feature commit (84 files) whose LDAP API surface carries the flaw as designed, not a security fix decomposed into a squash. AI decision: BIC-only attribution — the BIC object carries only the human maintainer Thorsten Rinne with no AI marker, so NOT_AI.
